rejectionRate.description: visitsRejected / (visitsCheckedIn + visitsRejected), 0..1; null when both are zero.

sealExceptionRate.description: sealExceptions per check-in; null when no visit checked in. Not capped at 1.

holdsByReason.description: Holds placed in the window; every reason is listed, zero included.

discrepancies.description: Total discrepancies (the length of YardCheckClosed.discrepancies) over the yard checks closed.

400.description: Malformed JSON body, an unknown field, a NUL byte, a missing or invalid Idempotency-Key, or an invalid path or query parameter (on the list operations an unknown query parameter, `limit`, `cursor` or filter value; on the reports the `from`/`to` window; on the yard policy an `If-Match` that is not an entity tag).

schema.description: RFC 7807 problem document used for every non-2xx response.
schema.title: Problem

value.title: Malformed request body
value.detail: request body is not valid JSON for this operation

value.title: Limit is invalid
value.detail: limit must be an integer between 1 and 500

value.title: Cursor is invalid

value.title: State is invalid
value.detail: state is not one of the values of this operation: "PARKING"

value.title: If-Match is invalid
value.detail: If-Match is not an entity tag of a policy version: "abc"

value.title: Report range is invalid
value.detail: from and to must be RFC 3339 instants, to after from and at most 92 days later
